_comment: City-agency newsrooms crawled by scrape_agencies.py. These are the NYC agencies on the LiveSite CMS whose press releases use a numeric, year-scoped URL id (so they can be enumerated by incrementing) AND share the standard article template the shared parser handles. id_format is a Python format string for the release id; the crawler fetches /site/<slug>/news/<id>/x (any slug works — the site redirects to the canonical URL) and walks ids upward until a run of misses. Display names map to SOURCE_LABEL in app.js. Agencies on other templates (Health /site/doh .page, DOT /html .shtml, FDNY's mixed prefixes) use different page structures and are a separate wave — see METHODOLOGY.md. City Hall (the Mayor's Office) is covered by scrape.py, not here.
_index_comment: Agencies on the slug-URL LiveSite template (ls-col-body) — no numeric ids, so crawled by scraping their press-release index page for links. require_2026 limits fetches to URLs containing the year (their indexes list releases back many years).
